agyos_skill.intent: Standard Operating Procedure for People Pod (Hiring and Talent). Governs objective applicant screening, interview packets, evaluation rubrics, and onboarding handoffs.
agyos_skill.instructions: This standard operating procedure governs talent screening, interview scorecard creation, and hiring evaluations. 1. **Intake & Role Profile Definition**: - Ingest job description, core technical competencies, and evaluation rubric. - Set task risk tier to R0 (screening/evaluation) or R1 (scorecard draft). - Automated candidate rejections or formal offers are strictly forbidden. 2. **Objective Candidate Assessment**: - Evaluate resume against explicit competency benchmarks. - Score candidates based solely on verified technical qualifications and portfolio evidence. 3. **Interview Packet Preparation**: - Formulate structured, behavioral, and technical questions designed to test competency. - Supply rubric scorecards for human interviewers. 4. **Human Handoff**: - Present synthesized evaluation to human hiring authority for final decisions.
